relations.subject: sdk:subdocument-operations
relations.evidence:
1. Use the `doc get` command to retrieve a document by ID.
3. Pipe the document through the `reject` filter to remove the field containing the Sub-Document.
4. Pipe the output, including the `id` and `content` fields, through the `doc replace` command to update the document.

notable_absence.finding: Like creating-data.md, this page never mentions RBAC/credential-type/privileges for the delete/remove KV operation, in contrast to the n1ql DELETE reference and guide pages which both carry explicit privilege tables.

cross_component_finding: cbsh has no native Sub-Document remove command; the page works around this by piping `doc get | reject <field> | doc replace` - a whole-document read-modify-write used to simulate a field-level delete. This is a genuinely task-level technique (a composition of two already-documented primitives, `doc get` and `doc replace`) rather than a new concept - it doesn't warrant a new concept id, but is worth noting as the clearest example in this batch of guide-level content going one level above pure statement/operation reference material. Also repeats, verbatim, the same warning banner and 'Key-Value Operations with SDKs' / 'Sub-Document operations with SDKs' related-links lists found identically in creating-data.md, reading-data.md, updating-data.md and bulk-operations.md.
